<!-- The following figures illustrate the hazard curves at the project site, in terms of spectral pseudo-accelerations  $S_a(T_n)$. Each figure presents annual exceedance probabilities (AEP) of exceeding some level of $S_a(T_n)$ obtained for different  $V_{s30}$  values and confidence levels, highlighting the epistemic uncertainty of the seismic hazard for rock site conditions. -->


```{r}
Vs30_TARGET <- 1100
TR_max <- 500000
Tn_TARGET <- c(0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1.0)
AEP <- AEPTable[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & SM=="openquake" & ID=="nrc_v3.19.1"]
CAP <-  "Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP) in terms of spectral pseudo-accelerations  Sa(Tn) for all structural periods Tn. Spectral ordinates were obtained for rock site conditions with Vs30 = %g  m/s (Quantile p=%s)"
```



::: {.panel-tabset  }

### Sa(Tn), p=50%

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}

p_TARGET <- 0.50
Caption <- CAP  |> sprintf(Vs30_TARGET,p_TARGET)


DATA <- AEP[ p == p_TARGET & Tn %in% Tn_TARGET & TR<=TR_max,.(ID=paste0("Tn= ",Tn," s"),X=Sa,Y=AEP)][order(X)]|> unique()
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  xAxis.label =TRUE,
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
line.size=THICK_LINE_SIZE,
xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.legend="AEP [1/yr]",
  xAxis.legend="Sa(Tn) [g]",
  group.legend="Tn [s]",
  data=DATA,
  plot.subtitle = Caption)
PLOT

```
